4.3.9.2 Cyclic Reception of Communication Data
[SWS_Rte_04657] The Cyclic Processing of the ComData ⌈If a ComData (system
signal or system signal group) is mapped to a VariableDataPrototype (via Rte-
ComDataVariableDataPrototypeInstanceRef), RTE shall perform the com-
plete read process within the cyclic function Rte_ComDataMainFunction of these
ComData including:
• Check if a new data is received.
• Retrieve the data received from COM module for these ComData (Signal/Signal-
Group). The data can be received by two ways:
– Using the stored data by Rte if the ComData is received data by Com Call-
backs.
– Using Com Receive APIs (e.g. Com_ReceiveSignalGroup).
• Execute the inverse data transformation, if applicable.
⌋
Note: Rte_ComDataMainFunction can process multiple ComData (system signal or
system signal group) according to The mapped RteComDataVariableDataProto-
typeInstanceRef.
Note: If the received VariableDataPrototype is not mapped to OsTask in Rte-
ComDataMapping (comHandlerTaskMappingEnabled is set to FALSE), then this
mapped ComData (signals/signal groups) will be processed within the context of the
upper layer (SWCs).
If Cyclic Reception is enabled and an error happens during the processing of ComData,
The RTE API Rte_Read returns the stored last value.
In order to handle communication jitter within a correct sequence for E2E transformer
calls the polling for received data has to be configured faster than the sending cycle
(oversampling).
